name: Slingshot

evidence.note: Band post invites fans to a night of dancing, dinner and drinks at Ristegio's.
Band post: bring your dancing shoes, the dance floor is open.
Organizer page calls Slingshot a Long Island dance band playing top 40 hits from all eras.
Cooperage Inn Fall Festival band list shows Slingshot on Sunday, Oct 4.

dancing.notes: Its posts promote nights of dinner, drinks and dancing with an open dance floor, so freestyle dancing to party hits is normal.

description: Long Island cover band that calls itself a dance band, playing top 40 hits from many eras at restaurants, bars and the Cooperage Inn Fall Festival, where it has played for eight seasons.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). The old band domain slingshotjams.com now shows unrelated adult content, so it is not linked. Facebook dancing posts date from 2022.
